name: /permissions
description: Open the permission picker to change what Codex can do without asking first.

examples.explanation: Open the permission picker for the active session.

when_to_use: Change approval requirements without restarting the session.
when_not_to_use: Do not relax permissions unless you understand the additional access being granted.

name: /model
description: Choose the active model and, when available, its reasoning effort for the current chat.

examples.explanation: Open the model and reasoning-effort picker.

when_to_use: Switch model behavior before starting a task.

name: /compact
description: Summarize the visible chat to free context-window capacity while retaining key information.

examples.explanation: Compact a long-running conversation before continuing.

when_to_use: Continue a long task when context capacity is becoming limited.
when_not_to_use: Use /clear when you want an unrelated fresh conversation.

name: /clear
description: Clear the terminal and start a fresh chat with empty conversation context.

examples.explanation: Start a fresh chat in the current CLI.

when_to_use: Begin an unrelated task without leaving Codex.
when_not_to_use: Use /compact when you need to preserve the current task context.

name: /review
description: Ask Codex to review the working tree for correctness and other actionable issues.
when_to_use: Check local changes before committing or opening a pull request.

conditions: Requires a Git working tree for change-oriented review.

name: /diff
description: Show the Git diff, including files that Git is not yet tracking.

examples.explanation: Inspect current edits before deciding what to do next.

when_to_use: Review the files and lines changed during a task.

conditions: Most useful inside a Git repository.

name: /status
description: Display session configuration, token usage, writable roots, approval policy, and context capacity.

examples.explanation: Inspect the current session configuration and usage.

when_to_use: Confirm which model and permission policy are active.

name: /plan
description: Switch to plan mode and optionally submit the first planning prompt.

examples.command: /plan Propose a migration plan for this service
examples.explanation: Enter plan mode with a concrete planning request.

when_to_use: Explore a multi-step approach before implementation begins.
when_not_to_use: The command is temporarily unavailable while Codex is already working.

conditions: Temporarily unavailable while Codex is already working.

name: /init
description: Generate an AGENTS.md scaffold in the current directory.

examples.explanation: Create a starter AGENTS.md for the repository.

when_to_use: Start documenting persistent repository instructions for Codex.

name: /mcp
description: List configured Model Context Protocol tools and optionally show detailed server information.

examples.explanation: Show MCP servers with detailed connection information.

when_to_use: Check which external tools Codex can call in the session.

name: /skills
description: Browse available skills and insert the selected skill context for the next request.
when_to_use: Apply a task-specific reusable workflow or instruction set.

name: /agent
description: Inspect agent threads and switch the active view to a spawned subagent thread.
when_to_use: Inspect or continue work in a spawned subagent thread.

conditions: Agent threads appear after subagents have been spawned.

name: /goal
description: Set, view, edit, pause, resume, or clear a persistent goal attached to the active chat.

examples.command: /goal Finish the migration and keep tests green
examples.explanation: Attach a concrete persistent objective to the chat.

when_to_use: Track a larger objective across multiple turns.
when_not_to_use: Do not use it for a one-turn request that does not need persistent tracking.

conditions: Goal objectives must be non-empty and no more than 4,000 characters.

name: /fork
description: Fork the current chat into a new chat so you can explore another direction without losing the original.

examples.explanation: Create a new chat from the current conversation state.

when_to_use: Try an alternative approach while preserving the current transcript.

name: /resume
description: Open the saved-chat list and resume an earlier CLI session.

examples.explanation: Choose a saved chat to continue.

when_to_use: Continue prior work without reconstructing its context.
